name: Brandon Royval
profileSummary: Brandon Matthew Royval is an American professional mixed martial artist. He currently competes in the Flyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). A professional since 2012, Royval has also formerly competed for Legacy Fighting Alliance, where he is a former Legacy Fighting Alliance Flyweight Champion. As of July 11, 2026, he is #3 in the Meta UFC flyweight rankings.
